title: AI-Assisted Weekly Planner
description: Use AI to help you plan your week more intelligently — prioritizing tasks, blocking time, and anticipating blockers.
steps: Write a brain dump of everything you need to do next week (no filtering)
Paste into AI: "Here is my task list. Group by: urgent+important, important-not-urgent, delegate/defer. Flag anything unrealistic given 5 working days."
Ask: "Given these tasks and a 40-hour week, can you create a rough daily schedule?"
Review and adjust — AI will not know your real constraints
Use this as your Monday morning planning ritual for 4 weeks
expectedOutput: A structured weekly plan with prioritized tasks, time blocks, and flagged risks.
bonusChallenges: At week end, review how the AI plan matched reality — what did it get wrong?
Build a prompt that includes your energy levels by time-of-day for better scheduling
